personal.name: Prathamesh Parab
personal.headline: Azure Solution Architect | Cloud Infrastructure | Azure Migration

summary_base: Azure Solution Architect and Cloud Infrastructure professional with 12+ years of IT experience and 6+ years in architecture-focused responsibilities, specializing in Microsoft Azure, enterprise cloud transformation, infrastructure modernization, migration, governance, networking, security, resiliency, container platforms, and Infrastructure as Code. Experienced in translating business and technical requirements into High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD), designing Azure Landing Zones, developing migration roadmaps, implementing governance guardrails, and leading end-to-end workload migrations.

achievements.text: 100+ servers / workloads migrated to Azure across end-to-end migration programs and customer environments.
50+ on-premises workloads migrated with 99.99% system availability during the delivery engagement.
15% operating cost reduction through Azure solution optimization and infrastructure standardization.
Built repeatable Azure deployment and operational automation using Terraform, Azure DevOps, PowerShell, and ARM templates.
Designed governance and architecture patterns using Azure Landing Zones, Azure Policy, Management Groups, RBAC, and enterprise networking.

bullets.text: Lead the design and implementation of complex Azure cloud infrastructure solutions aligned with business, security, availability, performance, and operational requirements.
Design and implement Azure Landing Zones aligned with the Azure Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Well-Architected Framework, including governance guardrails and standardized platform patterns.
Develop scalable target architectures and migration strategies for on-premises workloads moving to Azure; translate discovery outputs and business requirements into HLD, LLD, and migration roadmaps.
Implement governance using Azure Policy, Management Groups, Resource Locks, and RBAC to strengthen security, compliance, standardization, and operational control across Azure environments.
Automate Azure infrastructure deployment using Terraform integrated with Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines; use PowerShell and ARM templates for repeatable platform operations and automation.
Design Azure networking solutions using VNets, VPN Gateway, Load Balancer, Azure Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute, and Private Link patterns to support secure hybrid connectivity and workload isolation.

Lead customer and stakeholder discussions, technical discovery workshops, architecture reviews, solution documentation, and cross-functional coordination across infrastructure, security, application, and operations teams.
Drive cloud cost and operational optimization initiatives, including infrastructure standardization and automation, contributing to a reported 15% operating cost reduction.
Conducted Azure migration assessments and designed secure, scalable migration approaches for on-premises workloads.
Led migration activities for 50+ on-premises workloads to Azure while maintaining 99.99% system availability during delivery.
Automated infrastructure and operational processes using PowerShell, Terraform, and Azure Resource Manager templates.
Worked across Azure compute, networking, storage, backup, disaster recovery, and platform services to support business-critical workloads and migration programs.
Collaborated with engineering and customer teams to troubleshoot complex Azure issues and improve reliability, scalability, and operational readiness.
Supported enterprise infrastructure operations, service management, troubleshooting, and technical issue resolution across production environments.
Coordinated infrastructure activities with application and support teams to improve service stability and operational efficiency.
